messages.content:
Product of Array Except Self

Given an integer array nums, return an array answer such that answer[i] equals the product of all elements of nums except nums[i]. You must write an O(n) algorithm without using division.

Example: nums = [1,2,3,4] -> [24,12,8,6].
Constraints: 2 <= len(nums) <= 10^5.

Complexity check: one pass, O(n) time, O(n) auxiliary space for the map. That meets the constraint.

Constraints are small enough that the obvious approach fits, but the follow-up asks for the optimal one; going straight to it.
